The decisive mistake was the Assistant's at step 106. It declared that all listed restaurants were within a block of Washington Square Park and offered dine-in, but nothing in the run had verified either claim. Westville Hudson (333 Hudson St) and Awash (338 E 6th St) are not within a block of the park. The Assistant also never confirmed any vegan main under $15 at any restaurant, yet it wrote "TERMINATE," ending the run with the request unsatisfied. The final answer, Westville Hudson and Awash Ethiopian Restaurant, comes from the restaurants it listed as "confirmed." Earlier errors, such as the Orchestrator's shift to a casual/ethnic search at step 48, narrowed the search and made the miss more likely, but the Assistant's unverified termination is what produced the wrong answer.
